thread:
Sam K: Heads-up — ACME asked for a packaged 'customer-network template' we can drop into Private installs that preserves egress IPs, does BGP handshakes, and supports incremental upgrades with auto-rollback. They want it by the end of next sprint.
Liz P: ack. can we clarify "preserve egress IPs" — full IP passthrough or NAT with stable external IPs?
Sam K: they want stable external IPs for webhook allowlists. prefer NAT with preserved mapping, fallback to relay.
Maya R: ok, so we need installer flags + operator flow: 1) apply template 2) verify BGP session 3) validate egress mapping 4) promote. If validation fails, auto revert to previous operator bundle.
Raj S: question — how do we detect validation failure reliably? BGP peers up isn't enough; need traffic-level smoke tests (webhook roundtrip + egress IP check) and config diffs.
Maya R: exactly. propose a small test harness run during upgrade: curl to customer webhook, check src IP seen, run traceroute sanity, then check control plane metrics <5% error.
Liz P: what about offline/airgapped installs? Many customers run on-prem with no outbound access.
Sam K: for airgap we need a verification proxy they run in their net that can perform the webhook echo and report a signed success blob back to the controller. no external traffic required.
Raj S: related: rollback window. if upgrade fails within X minutes we auto-rollback. but if customer has long warmup jobs we need a manual override to extend X.
Maya R: propose defaults: X = 10m for most, extend via "upgrade.timeout" param in the template. and require explicit "force promote" for >1h.
ops-bot: deploy-check: new template schema v1.2 registered in staging. validation schema: network_template.v1.json -> added fields: "egress_preserve_mode","verification_proxy_config","upgrade.timeout"
Liz P: need docs for customer ops: sample BGP snippet, iptables/NAT example, operator CRD example. Also add a troubleshooting checklist: BGP hold timer mismatch, AS-path filters, ipam overlap.
Sam K: ship checklist for launch gating: 1) template schema validated in 3 customers (staging) 2) rollback path tested end-to-end 3) airgap verification flow validated 4) docs + quickstart + one-runbook for NetOps handoff.
Raj S: dependency callout: eng-runtime needs to expose operator snapshot hooks (snapshot-and-restore) + a safe checkpointing API. is that already in backlog?
Maya R: minimal runtime change: expose a control-plane checkpoint endpoint and hook for operator to trigger KV sync. I'll file spike.
Liz P: prioritization ask — rank this high if it unlocks 2 large customers. otherwise medium. Recommend include in next sprint if Maya spike completes by mid-week.
Sam K: good. action items: @Maya R file spike ticket, @Raj S draft verification tests, @Liz P start docs stub, I'll coordinate customer comms and sign-off criteria.
Maya R: will do.
Raj S: drafting tests now, will ping when ready for review.
